# Johnson Controls named to the 2026 Fortune 500 Europe list


September 30, 2026


Share


-
-
-
-


Johnson Controls has been named to the[Fortune 500 Europe](https://fortune.com/europe/ranking/fortune500-europe/) , an annual ranking that recognizes Europe's largest companies and serves as a benchmark of business performance and economic impact.


For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has helped customers solve some of their most complex building challenges, from improving energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions to managing critical building systems.


"We're honored to be recognized on the Fortune 500 Europe list," said Richard Lek, President, Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) at Johnson Controls. "This recognition is a testament to the trust our customers place in us and the commitment of our teams across Europe. Together, we're helping customers address complex challenges and advance the essential work they do. We are proud of what we've accomplished together and the value those partnerships continue to create."


This year's Fortune 500 Europe companies generated a combined $15.5 trillion in revenue, highlighting the scale and influence of these organizations driving growth and investment across the region.


Fortune ranks companies based on revenue from their most recently reported fiscal year.
